headline: Pasupati Acrylon secures Rs 334 crore ethanol allocation from OMCs
hook: Major ethanol supply boost for Pasupati Acrylon

modes.bear: Execution risks and fluctuating raw material costs could squeeze margins despite higher awarded volumes from OMCs.
modes.bull: A 57% jump in ethanol volume allocation significantly expands the company's revenue potential from green energy blending mandates.
modes.simple: The company received a much larger order to supply ethanol to oil companies, which can boost its business revenue this year.

summary: Pasupati Acrylon has bagged an ethanol allocation of 50,745 kilolitres worth Rs 334 crore from Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) for the upcoming supply period. This marks a significant volume increase of 57% compared to the previous year's allocation. For Indian retail investors, this sizable government-linked order provides revenue visibility for the company's bio-fuel segment.
whats_next: Execution of the ethanol supply order through the fiscal year
why_it_matters: Higher ethanol volume boosts revenue visibility for Pasupati Acrylon.

headline: Pasupati Acrylon reports financial results for period ending September 30, 2026
hook: September results out at Pasupati Acrylon
summary: Pasupati Acrylon Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance update for the quarter. Retail investors tracking micro-caps and small-cap chemical or textile inputs can review the results for revenue and margin trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers available for review by company shareholders
